module: 'Lights Debug' window of the live Vehicle Editor. Draws with debugDrawer the vehicle's light props (vdata.props whose mesh is SPOTLIGHT or POINTLIGHT): for a spot, a sphere, a direction line of length lightRange and an arrow head; for a point light, a sphere and a translucent sphere of radius lightRange. Options: spots, points, X-Ray (no depth test), names, unit vectors (length 1).
notes: Drawing is done in the onVehicleEditorRenderJBeams hook emitted by editor_veMain; the position comes from prop:getLiveTransformWorld() + vEditor.vehiclePos.
A null drawLine is drawn before each prop as a workaround for a debugDrawer bug (noted in the code).
setSolidTriCulling(false) is called every frame but never restored (commented-out line).

onVehicleEditorRenderJBeams.desc: Hook emitted by editor_veMain every render frame: draws the spots and point lights of the vehicle's props if the window is open.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: draws the window with the checkboxes.
